device.description: 12-bit 140/200 kSPS dual-channel (autosweep) serial SAR ADC with autopower-down
device.note: tlv2541.pdf (SLAS245E, TLV2541/TLV2542/TLV2545) p.1 pinouts, p.3 terminal functions, p.4 output data format (12 result bits + 4 don't-care, unipolar straight binary) and start of cycle (CPOL = 0, CPHA = 1), p.5 conversion (3.5 us after the 16th SCLK falling edge, result output in the next cycle), p.7 SCLK and conversion speed, p.9 recommended operating conditions and timing

pages: p.1 (pinouts), p.3 (terminal functions), p.4 (output data format, start of cycle), p.5 (MUX reset, sampling, conversion), p.5-6 (Figures 2-5), p.7 (SCLK and conversion speed), p.9 (recommended operating conditions and timing)
notModeled: analog inputs and VREF: every conversion returns the 0 V code (000h); the result shown in a frame is the previous cycle's conversion, which the constant code makes identical

conversion: started after the 16th SCLK falling edge, 3.5 us max on the internal oscillator (p.9); not timed (no bus-visible flag or pin); a CS rise before it completes aborts it and invalidates the next output (p.5, p.7)
D3-D0 are don't-care bits (p.4); modeled as zeros
SDO goes to Hi-Z after the 17th SCLK rising edge (td(SCLK17H-SDOZ) 60 ns at 2.7 V, p.9): modeled as idle Hi-Z after the 16-bit frame; tFloat uses the same 60 ns (no CS-rise-to-Z time is given)
the required SCLK falling edge while CS is high (p.4, p.7), sampling time (12 SCLKs from the 5th SCLK) and SCLK limits (Table 1)
autopower-down after each conversion and wake-up on CS falling (p.7): no bus-visible effect
timing at VDD = REF = 2.7 V (p.9): tValid = td(CSL-SDOV) 70 ns, tOut = td(SCLKH-SDOV) 21 ns

channel autosweep: the MUX toggles AIN0/AIN1 on each rising CS edge after a full cycle and resets to AIN0 after a short CS cycle of 4-7 SCLKs (p.5, Figure 4); not bus-visible with a constant 0 V code and no channel bits in the frame, so not modeled
variants: TLV2541 (single input, SCLK pin 5, FS pin 7), TLV2542 (dual input with autosweep, SCLK pin 7) and TLV2545 (pseudo-differential AIN(+)/AIN(-), SCLK pin 7) share tlv2541.pdf and the same 16-bit SDO frame.
